**Zero remaining actionable Standards findings.** All findings from the retained initial and follow-up reports are resolved:

- Missing advertised efforts remain unknown and block catalog admission; the regression now enables the role and reaches model eligibility.
- Validated encoded offering keys fit the documented public selection bound.
- Refresh and interrupted-open recovery share the bounded snapshot writer. Oversize interrupted recovery preserves the previous readable file, reports persistence failure, blocks new admissions, and leaves startup ownership cleanup and refresh retry available. It cannot replace the saved file with an unreadable oversized snapshot.

Reviewed regressions include near-limit interruption/reopen/refresh, oversized-refresh history preservation, shared picker/admission eligibility, frozen applied-team replay, and startup discovery-process cleanup. The retained logs show snapshot tests 5/5 and catalog-policy tests 6/6 passing. The earlier fixture failure remains diagnostic history and is not counted as passing evidence.

No additional actionable baseline smell. Private authentication, exact offering identity, bounded metadata discovery, frozen assignment recovery and independent process ownership remain aligned with `AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, and `docs/testing/mh4-model-contract.md`.

This is a static Standards review plus inspection of the focused logs. The root agent owns final full-suite/build/Clippy and live-execution validation; this report does not pre-claim their results. Earlier review files are retained unchanged.

This report carries forward the completed baseline review and the resolved findings in `spec-review-final.md`, then reviews the narrow `3c51dcc..f3c4706` delta. The original report and failing repro remain preserved.

The additional repair satisfies FOR-9's atomic persistence, interrupted-refresh recovery and admission-blocking contracts. A shared bounded writer now covers both accepted refresh snapshots and startup's interrupted-state rewrite. If added diagnostics would exceed 16 MiB, startup retains the readable disk snapshot, exposes the interrupted state and persistence error in memory, and blocks catalog admission. Workflow initialization can still perform owned-process cleanup; a new refresh clears interrupted diagnostics before attempting another bounded write. The near-limit regression covers retained disk bytes, blocked admission, visible interruption, subsequent refresh and reopen.

The unknown-effort regression now enables its fixture role, ensuring its admission assertion reaches capability validation instead of passing through the disabled-role guard.

The earlier lifecycle repairs remain intact: applied proposals bypass new-admission resolution; invalid pending proposals are durably rejected and release their matching transition; startup awaits discovery ownership cleanup before readiness. No new Spec regression identified.

This follow-up reviewed source and regression assertions. Final full-suite/native/live-adapter rerun evidence and repository/Linear completion records are being assembled by the coordinating agent and remain separate acceptance obligations.
